subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Police who did not understand the orthodox methods of the Black Hood suspected him of numeruos crimes.
Police who did not understand the urthodox methods of the Black Hood suspected him of numerous crimes.
Police who did not understand the orthodox methuds of the Black Hood suspected him of numerous crimes.
Police who did not understand the orthodox methods of the Black Hood suspected him of numerous crimes.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"orthodox"** means conforming to what is generally or traditionally accepted as right or true; established and approved. (परंपरागत)

 
 
• **Example: **He follows an** orthodox **approach to the practice of medicine.
 
 
 
• **"numerous" **means great in number; many. (असंख्य)
 
 
• **Example: **There are** numerous** ways to solve this problem.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the sentence with no spelling errors is Option 4.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1**: "numeruos" is incorrect. The correct spelling is "numerous" (असंख्य).

 
 
• **Example: **There are numerous opportunities available in the city.
 
 
 
• **Option 2**: "urthodox" is incorrect. The correct spelling is "orthodox" (परंपरागत).
 
 
• **Example: **He has very orthodox views on religion.
 
 
 
• **Option 3**: "methuds" is incorrect. The correct spelling is "methods" (तरीके).
 
 
• **Example: **Different methods can be used to reach the same goal.
 
 

32:Tb55,

The correct answer is: Option 4.</
